{{Quote|I went to the Security Police, of course. They made an appearance of concern, but it was clear that they had no intention of exerting themselves.|Rekkon|<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>}}
The '''Security Police''', or in contracted form, the '''Espos''' (or '''boys-in-brown''' in [[deal-slang]]), were the officers of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Ground Forces/Legends|Ground Forces]] responsible for [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]]. The name Espo was also a slang term used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to refer to members of the organization.

==Description==
[[File:Espo_Troopers_TCG_by_Nash.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Espo troopers making an arrest]]
Espos had a reputation for brutality throughout the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. They were distinguished by their [[Espo Armor|brown uniforms]] and [[KZZ riot armor]]. Armed with [[500 riot gun/Legends|riot guns]], [[Merr-Sonn stun baton]]s and [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[Riot shield/Legends|riot shields]], they used brutal and even lethal force against rioters and other sorts of "disobedient" beings and sometimes [[Torture/Legends|severe interrogative tactics]]. They were widely known for their use of the [[FC-1 flechette launcher/Legends|FC-1 flechette launcher]]. Espos also had access to heavier weaponry, such as [[Espo grenade mortar|mortars]] and [[Espo Walker|walkers]]. Individuals who were convicted of political crimes within the Corporate Sector were sentenced to terms at a secret prison called [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]].

==History==
[[File:Agent_of_the_Emperor_-_LotDS_FFG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Mara Jade hiding from police on Shelkonwa]]
At some point, the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] hid behind a wall from two members of the Security Police on<ref name="AotE">{{FFGTCG|set=Lure of the Dark Side|cardname=Agent of the Emperor}}</ref> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Shelkonwa]].<ref name="AotE" />
